name: Custom pet portrait print-on-demand store
one_liner: A Shopify store that sells custom pet portraits in a set style (like Renaissance), printed and shipped by a print-on-demand supplier.
customer: Pet owners and people buying gifts for pet owners
offer: Personalised pet portrait art on canvas, posters and other products, made from the customer's photo
how_it_makes_money: Sells each product for well above what the print-on-demand supplier and the artist charge; paid ads bring in customers
startup_cost: low - about $40 (around $30 for Shopify plus small extras)
time_to_first_revenue: days to weeks (the store was built in one weekend)
evidence: 'built a seven figure business from a $40 investment' - 3GmZHYBX75s
'first full year ended up closing out at just over a million dollars in revenue' - 3GmZHYBX75s
'paid the $30 for the Shopify membership... built out the whole website' - 3GmZHYBX75s
Downside: 'sales are down and he's out of ideas' - 3GmZHYBX75s
risks: Many competitors offer the same thing
Depends on paid ads, so profit falls when ad costs rise
The early growth came from the Covid pet boom
Customer acquisition cost versus order value has to work on the first sale, since few e-commerce customers buy again (4XQ50qWSRO4)

name: Lead-gen website rental (rank and rent)
one_liner: Build local websites that rank in search and bring in leads for a service trade, then rent each site to a local business for a monthly fee.
customer: Local service businesses, such as trades and home services
offer: A website that delivers a steady flow of leads or calls in their area
how_it_makes_money: Monthly rent per site; the founder says some sites bring in $4-5k a month, and he wants $30-40k a month from the biggest ones
startup_cost: low-medium (not stated; mainly domains, content and SEO time)
time_to_first_revenue: unknown (months, because sites need time to rank)
evidence: 'We finished the month, 192.5 last month' - 6ErnEr2JcD0
'over 90% net profit margins'; 2-3 hours a week - 6ErnEr2JcD0
'I know three people that have made more than a million bucks just since 2022' - 6ErnEr2JcD0
'I'm literally just calling the person and saying, hey, I've got customers that want this' - 6ErnEr2JcD0
risks: Google algorithm updates can cut traffic
Ranking takes months before any rent comes in
Getting tenants means some calls with business owners
Results are one founder's own account

name: Content brand that sells niche software
one_liner: Build an audience with free content (YouTube, podcast, email list) and use it to sell your own niche SaaS, then sell the SaaS to a buyer.
customer: Website owners and marketers (here, SEO publishers)
offer: A software tool for that niche (Link Whisper, a WordPress internal-linking plugin)
how_it_makes_money: Software subscriptions or licences, then a sale of the business
startup_cost: medium (not stated; software build plus years of content)
time_to_first_revenue: unknown (slow; the content was built over 15 years)
evidence: 'I've sold millions of dollars worth of software over the years' - 3BdRE-vh3Ms
'more and more businesses reaching out to me asking to acquire Link Whisper... decided that it was time to sell' - 3BdRE-vh3Ms
635 old videos still drove growth to 100k subscribers - 3BdRE-vh3Ms
risks: Takes a long time to build an audience
Needs software development skills or a budget for it
Survivorship bias: this is one well-known creator

name: Reselling Amazon return pallets
one_liner: Buy pallets of liquidated Amazon returns and resell the items one by one on eBay or local marketplaces.
customer: Second-hand buyers on eBay and marketplaces
offer: Returned appliances and household goods at a discount
how_it_makes_money: Selling items for more than the pallet cost (one pallet cost $700; items valued at $40-100 each)
startup_cost: medium - about $700 per pallet, plus storage and transport
evidence: 'I Paid $700 for a HUGE Amazon Returns Pallet' - 4m7tDeaw5Y0
Item values estimated: 'these go for anywhere from $40 to $100' (no realised profit shown, so evidence is weak) - 4m7tDeaw5Y0
risks: Items can be broken or unknown
Hands-on physical work
Needs space
Margins are uncertain

name: Fresh lemonade cart for markets and events
one_liner: A fresh-squeezed lemonade stand at farmers markets and events, also hired out for weddings.
customer: Farmers market visitors, event organisers and wedding couples
offer: Fresh lemonade sold by the cup, plus cart hire for cocktail hours
how_it_makes_money: Per-cup sales at events, plus booking fees for private hire
startup_cost: low (not stated; 'you could technically do this with a muddler and a knife')
evidence: 'In 3 hours, we did almost like $6,000' - 5TZylaKGWUE
'You tried it and you made 12 grand in profit' (one event) - 5TZylaKGWUE
Expanding into wedding hire because 'it's such a big hit' - 5TZylaKGWUE
risks: Must be there in person, so a poor fit for async work
Depends on the season and the weather (especially in the UK)
Needs food-hygiene permits

name: AI character or influencer accounts
one_liner: Create a consistent AI-generated character, grow its social following, and earn money through sponsorships and products.
customer: Brands buying sponsorships and fans buying products
offer: Sponsored posts and merch or digital products from the AI persona
how_it_makes_money: Sponsorship deals and product sales; the case shown made money from a meme coin, which this ignores
startup_cost: low (mainly AI tool subscriptions such as Higgsfield)
evidence: Jean Phil got '79 million views and over 240,000 followers on IG' in about 2 weeks - 45J4IbJxwhc
Weak: no revenue from sponsorships or products was shown; the money came from a speculative meme coin - 45J4IbJxwhc
risks: Trends fade quickly
Platform rules on AI content
Unclear how it makes money
Legal and ethical risk around meme coins

name: Deepfake and voice-clone protection for families and small businesses
one_liner: A service that helps families and small businesses avoid AI voice-clone and deepfake scams and prove which content is real.
customer: Families and small business finance teams
offer: Scam-awareness training, verification procedures and authenticity checks
how_it_makes_money: Not stated; possibly paid training packs or a subscription
evidence: 'Voice cloning cost a mom $15,000'; '$25 million after a video call with executives who weren't even real' - 3oWmy7F-Ja0
Weak: offered as an idea only ('a wide-open lane'), with no business shown making money - 3oWmy7F-Ja0
risks: No proven customer willing to pay
Large security companies and banks are already moving in
Trust and credibility are hard to build
